description: This PHP script appears to be part of a web application related to test management, specifically handling the viewing of requirement revisions within the TestLink open-source test management system. It initializes page components, processes input arguments, manages user permissions, interacts with requirement and project managers, and renders a template for displaying requirement revision details.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used for creating simple object containers.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for Smarty templating system, used here for template assignments and display.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Project management class for handling test project details, such as prefix retrieval.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Manager class responsible for handling requirement data, including version and revision management, and HTML rendering of custom fields.

classes.name: reqCommands
classes.description: Class managing command operations related to requirements, such as initializing GUI components.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing request parameters, test project information, and user ID.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI context for viewing a requirement revision, including fetching requirement data, permissions, and configuration.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies whether the current user has appropriate rights to view or modify requirements in the given context.
